tagline.en_US: NetAlertX discovers devices on your local network and tracks its device inventory in a self-hosted web interface.

description.en_US: NetAlertX is a network visibility and asset intelligence platform designed for homelabs and IT environments. It provides continuous asset discovery and centralized inventory tracking across local subnets, VLANs, and remote sites from a single interface. The system monitors connection state changes, helps detect unauthorized hardware, and sends alerts through various notification services.
